title: Ground Penetrating Radar
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.U.S. AIR FORCES IN EUROPE.FA5682 31 CONS (UNIT 6102)
description_text: nr. 1 -ground penetrating radar (GPR) which shall easily pair with external Bluetooth-enabled GPS, including a built-in GPS pole adapter, Map Mode capable of tracing the operator steps and gain a bird’s-eye view of the survey. It shall place APWA color-coded marks on 2D data and geo-referenced map simultaneously, collect and create 3D scans. A Rugged Ethernet cable is required for communication between tablet and Antenna where no Wi-Fi is allowed. GPR and tablet shall be rated IP65 to withstand rain, dust and extreme temperatures from -20°C (-4°F) to 40 °C (104°F).
